metric_definitions.task_pass_rate: Number of tasks with an official-verifier pass divided by the declared task denominator; terminal task failure remains in the denominator.
metric_definitions.redundant_exploration: Repeated code-navigation, search or read exploration of the same source target across sessions; exact event key and aggregation await the run protocol.
metric_definitions.uncached_input_tokens: Provider-reported input tokens minus cached input tokens; aggregation and paired cohort await the usage records.
metric_definitions.time_to_first_correct_verifier_pass: Elapsed time from the declared continuation boundary to the first official verifier pass of the correct modification; median on the protocol-defined cohort.
metric_definitions.typed_decision_accuracy: Correct decision labels divided by all independently annotated decisions.
metric_definitions.gate_bypass_rate: Observed unauthorized gate bypasses divided by adversarial cases.
metric_definitions.inference_latency: Elapsed model-inference time under the declared latency boundary; summary statistic awaits the router run protocol.
